## 💡 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of what the feature would do.

## 🤔 Motivation

Why would this feature be useful? What problem does it solve?

## 📋 Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📸 Examples

Provide examples, mockups, or references (if applicable).

## 🎯 How It Aligns with Project Goals

How does this feature align with the project's philosophy of simplicity, performance, and intentionality?

## 📝 Additional Context

Add any other context or information about the feature request.

## 🔍 Checklist

- [ ] This feature aligns with project philosophy
- [ ] I've checked existing issues for similar requests
- [ ] This is not a duplicate request
